items.title_zh: 运动想象脑机接口流水线（mi-bci-pipeline）
bullets_zh: BurhanxGodhra于2026年9月在GitHub发布端到端实时运动想象BCI流水线。
该流水线结合EEGNet、ONNX Runtime和Lab Streaming Layer，覆盖训练部署、实时推理、意图检测与辅助设备监控。
可作为构建非侵入式EEG控制系统的实用开源参考。
bullets_en: BurhanxGodhra released an end-to-end real-time motor imagery BCI pipeline on GitHub in September 2026.
It combines EEGNet, ONNX Runtime, and Lab Streaming Layer for training, deployment, live inference, intent detection, and assistive-device monitoring.
Useful as a practical open-source reference for building non-invasive EEG control systems.
items.brief: 开源实时运动想象EEG BCI流水线，支持训练部署与意图检测。
items.brief_en: Open-source real-time motor imagery EEG BCI pipeline for training, deployment, and intent detection.
items.raw_excerpt: End-to-end real-time Motor Imagery BCI pipeline using EEGNet, ONNX Runtime, and Lab Streaming Layer (LSL) — from EEG training and deployment to live inference, intent detection, and assistive-device monitoring.

items.title_zh: 面向运动想象信号处理的 EEG MCP 服务器（eeg-mcp）
items.title_en: EEG MCP Server for Motor Imagery Signal Processing (eeg-mcp)
bullets_zh: Am1r-codes于2026年9月在GitHub发布EEG MCP服务器。
该工具实现经MNE验证的运动想象EEG信号核心，并通过模型上下文协议（MCP）暴露接口。
便于AI代理或应用程序以编程方式访问非侵入式EEG处理流水线。
bullets_en: Am1r-codes published an EEG MCP server on GitHub in September 2026.
It implements a motor imagery EEG signal core validated against MNE and exposes it through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Helps AI agents or applications access non-invasive EEG processing pipelines programmatically.
items.brief: 经MNE验证的运动想象EEG核心通过MCP暴露，便于AI访问非侵入式BCI处理。
